degree_rationale: Three Wells from which rains/calls fall — first from rooted realms above into earth-bodies; second from temples to trees; third from firmament-dwellers to flesh. Illumines the call-and-response mechanism between heaven and earth.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing how 'rain' (cosmic summons) descends in three differently-rooted modes. Illumines the heaven-to-earth flow.
grand_man_function: Spiritual rain-mechanism illumined — the threefold call of life from heaven.
title: How rain falls in three differently caused ways
